::: {.store-lede}
Every play of every game: situation, gamebook description, play type, yardage, passer, rusher and receiver, scoring, turnovers, penalties, kicking, timeouts and drive results, plus nflfastR's expected points, win probability and completion probability estimates. Regular season and playoffs are in the same file, told apart by season_type and game_type; the preseason is not included. Rows that are not plays (timeouts, end of quarter) are kept so the game reads in order. Tackle-by-tackle defensive credits and formation or personnel charting are not included.
:::

## Columns

One row per play. 142 columns. A row is identified by `game_id` + `play_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>nflverse game id: season, week, away team and home team (2023_01_DET_KC); joins every NFL file.</td></tr>
<tr><td>play_id</td><td>int</td><td>The NFL&#x27;s id for the play, unique within a game; ids are not always in playing order.</td></tr>
<tr><td>play_seq</td><td>int</td><td>Order of the play within the game, starting at 1.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>NFL season, named for the year it starts (the 2023 season ends with the February 2024 Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>REG for the regular season, POST for the playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>Round of the season: REG (regular season), WC (wild card), DIV (divisional), CON (conference championship), SB (Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>week</td><td>int</td><td>Week of the season; playoff weeks continue the count after the last regular-season week.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in US Eastern time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team</td><td>string</td><td>Home team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team</td><td>string</td><td>Away team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).</td></tr>
<tr><td>quarter</td><td>int</td><td>Quarter of the play; 5 and above are overtime periods.</td></tr>
<tr><td>clock</td><td>string</td><td>Game clock at the snap, minutes and seconds left in the quarter (MM:SS).</td></tr>
<tr><td>quarter_seconds_remaining</td><td>int</td><td>Seconds left in the quarter at the snap.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_seconds_remaining</td><td>int</td><td>Seconds left in the game at the snap; in overtime it counts down the overtime period.</td></tr>
<tr><td>time_of_day</td><td>datetime</td><td>Wall-clock time of the play in UTC, where the NFL recorded it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>possession_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team with the ball (nflfastR posteam); on a kickoff this is the receiving team, and it is blank on rows that are not plays.</td></tr>
<tr><td>defense_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team without the ball (nflfastR defteam).</td></tr>
<tr><td>yardline_100</td><td>int</td><td>Yards from the possession team to the opponent&#x27;s end zone, 1 to 99.</td></tr>
<tr><td>yard_line</td><td>string</td><td>Ball position as written in the gamebook, for example KC 35.</td></tr>
<tr><td>down</td><td>int</td><td>Down, 1 to 4; blank on kickoffs, extra points, two-point tries and rows that are not plays.</td></tr>
<tr><td>yards_to_go</td><td>int</td><td>Yards needed for a first down.</td></tr>
<tr><td>goal_to_go</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the offense is in a goal-to-go situation.</td></tr>
<tr><td>drive</td><td>int</td><td>Drive number within the game, counting both teams&#x27; drives, as numbered by nflfastR.</td></tr>
<tr><td>series</td><td>int</td><td>Series number within the game; a new series starts with each first down or change of possession.</td></tr>
<tr><td>possession_team_score</td><td>int</td><td>Possession team&#x27;s score before the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>defense_team_score</td><td>int</td><td>Defense team&#x27;s score before the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>score_differential</td><td>int</td><td>Possession team&#x27;s score minus the defense team&#x27;s score before the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>total_home_score</td><td>int</td><td>Home team&#x27;s score after the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>total_away_score</td><td>int</td><td>Away team&#x27;s score after the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_timeouts_remaining</td><td>int</td><td>Timeouts the home team has left in the half.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_timeouts_remaining</td><td>int</td><td>Timeouts the away team has left in the half.</td></tr>
<tr><td>description</td><td>string</td><td>The play as written in the NFL gamebook.</td></tr>
<tr><td>play_type</td><td>string</td><td>nflfastR play type: pass (sacks included), run, punt, kickoff, field_goal, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike or no_play (a play wiped out by a penalty); blank on rows that are not plays, such as timeouts and the end of a quarter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>play_type_nfl</td><td>string</td><td>The NFL&#x27;s own play type label, such as PASS, RUSH, SACK, PENALTY or TIMEOUT.</td></tr>
<tr><td>yards_gained</td><td>int</td><td>Yards gained or lost by the offense on the play, penalty yards excluded.</td></tr>
<tr><td>shotgun</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback lined up in shotgun.</td></tr>
<tr><td>no_huddle</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the offense ran the play without a huddle.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_dropback</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback dropped back: a pass attempt, sack or scramble.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_scramble</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback scrambled.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_kneel</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback knelt.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_spike</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback spiked the ball.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_attempt</td><td>bool</td><td>True on pass plays as nflfastR flags them, which includes sacks; official attempts are complete_pass, incomplete_pass and interception.</td></tr>
<tr><td>complete_pass</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the pass was completed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>incomplete_pass</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the pass was incomplete.</td></tr>
<tr><td>interception</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the pass was intercepted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>sack</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback was sacked.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rush_attempt</td><td>bool</td><td>True on running plays, scrambles included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_length</td><td>string</td><td>short or deep, as charted by the NFL (deep is 15 or more air yards).</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_location</td><td>string</td><td>left, middle or right.</td></tr>
<tr><td>air_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Yards the pass travelled past the line of scrimmage to the target, complete or not.</td></tr>
<tr><td>yards_after_catch</td><td>int</td><td>Yards gained by the receiver after the catch.</td></tr>
<tr><td>run_location</td><td>string</td><td>left, middle or right.</td></tr>
<tr><td>run_gap</td><td>string</td><td>end, tackle or guard; blank for runs up the middle.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_hit</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the quarterback was hit on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>aborted_play</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play was aborted, for example a fumbled snap.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_down</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play gained a first down, by rush, pass or penalty.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_down_rush</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a rush gained the first down.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_down_pass</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a pass gained the first down.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_down_penalty</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a penalty gave the first down.</td></tr>
<tr><td>third_down_converted</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a third down was converted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>third_down_failed</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a third down was not converted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fourth_down_converted</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a fourth down was converted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fourth_down_failed</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a fourth-down try failed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>passer_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the passer; also set on sacks.</td></tr>
<tr><td>passer_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Passer, as abbreviated in the gamebook (P.Mahomes).</td></tr>
<tr><td>passing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Passing yards credited on the play, yards after a lateral included; blank unless a pass was completed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>receiver_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the targeted receiver.</td></tr>
<tr><td>receiver_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Targeted receiver, as abbreviated in the gamebook.</td></tr>
<tr><td>receiving_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Receiving yards credited to the receiver, yards after a lateral excluded; blank unless a pass was completed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rusher_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the ball carrier.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rusher_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Ball carrier, as abbreviated in the gamebook.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rushing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Rushing yards credited to the ball carrier, yards after a lateral excluded.</td></tr>
<tr><td>lateral_receiver_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the teammate who took a lateral after a catch.</td></tr>
<tr><td>lateral_receiving_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Receiving yards credited to the player who took the lateral.</td></tr>
<tr><td>lateral_rusher_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the teammate who took a lateral on a run.</td></tr>
<tr><td>lateral_rushing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Rushing yards credited to the player who took the lateral.</td></tr>
<tr><td>scoring_play</td><td>bool</td><td>True if points were scored on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>touchdown</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play ended in a touchdown for either team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>td_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team that scored the touchdown.</td></tr>
<tr><td>td_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the touchdown scorer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>td_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Touchdown scorer, as abbreviated in the gamebook.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_touchdown</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the touchdown came on a completed pass.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rush_touchdown</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the touchdown came on a run.</td></tr>
<tr><td>return_touchdown</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the touchdown came on a return: interception, fumble, kickoff or punt.</td></tr>
<tr><td>safety</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play ended in a safety.</td></tr>
<tr><td>extra_point_result</td><td>string</td><td>good, failed, blocked or aborted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>two_point_attempt</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play was a two-point try.</td></tr>
<tr><td>two_point_conv_result</td><td>string</td><td>success or failure of the two-point try.</td></tr>
<tr><td>field_goal_result</td><td>string</td><td>made, missed or blocked.</td></tr>
<tr><td>kick_distance</td><td>int</td><td>Distance of the kick in yards: field-goal or extra-point attempt, kickoff or punt.</td></tr>
<tr><td>kicker_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the kicker on field goals, extra points and kickoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>kicker_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Kicker, as abbreviated in the gamebook.</td></tr>
<tr><td>punt_blocked</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the punt was blocked.</td></tr>
<tr><td>touchback</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play ended in a touchback.</td></tr>
<tr><td>punter_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the punter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>punt_returner_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the punt returner.</td></tr>
<tr><td>kickoff_returner_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the kickoff returner.</td></tr>
<tr><td>return_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team that returned the kick, punt, interception or fumble.</td></tr>
<tr><td>return_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Yards gained on the return.</td></tr>
<tr><td>interception_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the defender who intercepted the pass.</td></tr>
<tr><td>sack_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the defender credited with a full sack.</td></tr>
<tr><td>half_sack_1_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the first defender on a shared sack (half a sack each).</td></tr>
<tr><td>half_sack_2_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the second defender on a shared sack.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the ball was fumbled on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble_lost</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the fumbling team lost the ball.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumbled_1_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team of the first player to fumble on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumbled_1_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the first player to fumble.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble_recovery_1_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team that made the first fumble recovery.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble_recovery_1_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the first player to recover a fumble.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumbled_2_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team of a second, different player who fumbled on the same play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumbled_2_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of a second, different player who fumbled on the same play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble_recovery_2_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team that made the second fumble recovery on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumble_recovery_2_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the player who made the second fumble recovery.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a penalty was accepted on the play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team the penalty was called on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id of the penalized player; blank for team penalties.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty_type</td><td>string</td><td>The foul, such as False Start or Defensive Pass Interference.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Yards the penalty moved the ball.</td></tr>
<tr><td>timeout</td><td>bool</td><td>True if a timeout was called.</td></tr>
<tr><td>timeout_team</td><td>string</td><td>Team that called the timeout.</td></tr>
<tr><td>replay_or_challenge</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play was reviewed or challenged.</td></tr>
<tr><td>replay_or_challenge_result</td><td>string</td><td>upheld, reversed or denied.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ep</td><td>float</td><td>Expected points for the possession team before the play; an nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>epa</td><td>float</td><td>Expected points added by the play for the possession team; an nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>qb_epa</td><td>float</td><td>EPA credited to the quarterback: the play&#x27;s EPA, with a completion that ends in a lost fumble valued as if the catch had stood; an nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>success</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the play&#x27;s EPA is above zero; follows the nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wp</td><td>float</td><td>Win probability of the possession team before the play, from nflfastR&#x27;s model that uses game state only (no betting line).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_wp</td><td>float</td><td>Win probability of the home team before the play, from the same nflfastR model.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wpa</td><td>float</td><td>Win probability added by the play for the possession team; an nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>cp</td><td>float</td><td>Probability the pass is completed given its depth, location and situation; an nflfastR model estimate.</td></tr>
<tr><td>cpoe</td><td>float</td><td>Completion percentage over expected for the pass, in percentage points: 100 times (1 for a completion, 0 for an incompletion, minus cp).</td></tr>
<tr><td>series_result</td><td>string</td><td>How the series ended: First down, Touchdown, Punt, Field goal, Turnover and so on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>drive_result</td><td>string</td><td>How the drive ended: Touchdown, Field goal, Punt, Turnover, Turnover on downs, Missed field goal, End of half, Opp touchdown or Safety.</td></tr>
<tr><td>drive_time_of_possession</td><td>string</td><td>Time the drive took (M:SS), from the NFL&#x27;s drive summary.</td></tr>
<tr><td>drive_start_transition</td><td>string</td><td>How the offense got the ball: KICKOFF, PUNT, INTERCEPTION, FUMBLE, DOWNS and so on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>drive_end_transition</td><td>string</td><td>How the drive ended, in the NFL&#x27;s drive summary terms: TOUCHDOWN, FIELD_GOAL, PUNT, INTERCEPTION and so on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>roof</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium roof: outdoors, dome, or closed / open for a retractable roof.</td></tr>
<tr><td>surface</td><td>string</td><td>Playing surface, such as grass or fieldturf.</td></tr>
<tr><td>temperature_f</td><td>int</td><td>Temperature at kickoff in degrees Fahrenheit; blank for domes and closed roofs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_mph</td><td>int</td><td>Wind speed at kickoff in miles per hour; blank for domes and closed roofs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>weather</td><td>string</td><td>Weather line from the gamebook: conditions, temperature, humidity and wind.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stadium</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium name.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Source: nflverse (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0): play-by-play from nflfastR, games and schedules as maintained by Lee Sharpe. Changes: columns were selected and renamed, a few repeated plays removed, and the game logs added up from the play-by-play. EPA, win probability, completion probability and expected yards after the catch are nflfastR model estimates.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More NFL data

[Player Game Logs](nfl-player-logs.qmd) · [Team Game Logs](nfl-team-logs.qmd) · [Games and Results](nfl-schedule.qmd) · [All NFL data](nfl.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the NFL files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every NFL file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and playoff game, built from the open nflverse play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
